dataset.target: Final regular-minute close / exact entry-minute open - 1; zero expense
dataset.cohort: Frozen baseline morning Rank, cached top-20 candidates; never pooled with all-21 or mutable live scores
dataset.morning_feature_contract: Six close-known columns from the frozen baseline training frame, already shifted by build_training_frame; never read the current day's live feature row.
limitations: Earlier-trained research baseline rankings, not immutable historical live publications or the current production feature subset.
Lower ranks are selectively cached, with sparse support; this is not complete top-20 coverage.
Repeated intraday snapshots are correlated; split and weight by whole session dates.
Minute bars are hypothetical execution prices; missing observations remain unknown.
Top-20 score normalization removes arbitrary scale but does not establish transfer calibration across morning-model versions.
dataset.evaluation_status: Retrospective reused evaluation; not fresh confirmation

notes: Experimental: predicts price change from the observed entry to today's cash close, with zero assumed expenses.
Profit means a close above entry. Close loss >2% means a terminal loss, not touching a price during the day.
Chronological 60% fit / 20% sigmoid calibration / 20% evaluation already inspected in earlier research. The evaluated artifact is saved without refitting.
Rank 1 is the primary evaluation. Other ranks have sparse, cache-selected historical coverage.
Historical morning ranks came from a frozen research model. Current production rank/score context may differ; normalized scores do not eliminate this shift.
The clock baseline and logistic benchmark use fitting sessions only. Repeated checkpoints are weighted within stock-day and date.
Rank 1 probability error did not beat both simple baselines. Treat these odds as experimental, not an established improvement.
